overview: Next.js 14 app using server actions ('use server') for API communication. Migrating from Next.js unstable_cache to TanStack Query (React Query) for client-side caching. Server actions call a REST API at process.env.API_URL using Bearer token auth from NextAuth session.

schemas.User: { id, name, email, password, balance: number, totalBudget: number }
schemas.Category: { id, name, color, icon, type: TxType, updatedAt?, deletedAt? }
schemas.CategoryBudget: Category & { createdAt, budget: number, totalExpenses: number }
schemas.Movement: { userId?, type: TxType, categoryId, tagId?, tagName, amount, description, createdAt?, financialElementId? }
schemas.Movements: Movement & { id, lastBalance, createdAt, updatedAt?, deletedAt?, user: User, tag: Tags, category: Category }
schemas.FinancialElements: FinancialElement & { id, createdAt, currentAmount, movements: Movements[] }

utils.description: Base HTTP methods used by all actions. All require a valid NextAuth session (accessToken). On 401, signs out and redirects to /login?expired=true.

functions.getSession: Returns the current NextAuth session (Session | null)
functions.getMethod<T>(url, id?): GET request with session auth. Builds endpoint as API_URL/url or API_URL/url/id
functions.getMethodWithoutSession<T>(url, session,: GET without calling getSession internally — needed for unstable_cache wrappers where async calls inside cache are restricted
functions.postMethod<T>(url, body?, requiresAuth?): POST request. requiresAuth defaults to true; set false for /user/register
functions.deleteMethod<T>(url, id): DELETE request to API_URL/url/id. Returns null if response body is empty

functions.authenticate(prevState, formData): Login form action. Calls NextAuth signIn('credentials'). Returns Spanish error strings mapped from lastAuthError codes.
functions.logOut(): Calls revalidatePath('/', 'layout') then signOut({ redirectTo: '/' }). Used by useLogout hook.

functions.register(prevState, formData): Registers user via POST /user/register then auto-signs in. Validates name/email/password with Zod. Redirects to /dashboard/mapa on success.
functions.getProfile(): GET /user/profile. Returns full User object including balance. Previously wrapped in unstable_cache — now fetches fresh every call. Replaced by useProfile hook.
functions.putUser(data): PATCH /user/:sessionUserId. Updates name, totalBudget, or balance. No hook yet.
functions.revalidateUser(): Calls revalidateTag('user'). Legacy — should be replaced by queryClient.invalidateQueries(['user-profile']) in hooks.

functions.getCategoriesByUser(): GET /category/user/:userId. Returns Category[]. Replaced by useCategories hook.
functions.getBudgetByUserAndPeriod(startDate?, end: GET /category/user/:userId/budget?startDate&endDate. Defaults to current month range. Returns CategoryBudget[]. Fresh fetch, no cache.
functions.getBudgetByUserAndPeriodCached(startDate: DEPRECATED — same as above but wrapped in unstable_cache (tag: 'category-budget', revalidate: 3600). Still called in dashboardContext.tsx. Should be replaced by useBudget hook (not yet implemented).
functions.postCategory(data): POST /category with { name, icon, color, type, userId }. Replaced by useCreateCategory hook.
functions.putCategory(id, data): PATCH /category/:id. Calls revalidateTag('categoryBudget') if budget changed. Hook useUpdateCategory exists but is empty.
functions.deleteCategoryById(id): DELETE /category/:id (soft delete on API). Replaced by useDeleteCategory hook.
functions.revalidateCategoriesBudget(): Calls revalidateTag('category-budget'). Legacy — still called in historial/page.tsx and presupuesto/page.tsx.

functions.getMovementsByUserAndFilter(filters?): GET /movement?userId&categoryId?&tagId?&startDate?&endDate=. Returns Movements[]. Fresh fetch. Will be used by useMovements hook (not yet implemented).
functions.getMovementsByUserAndFilterCache(filters: DEPRECATED — same as above wrapped in unstable_cache (tag: 'movements', revalidate: 3600). Not called anywhere in app currently — dead code.
functions.postMovement(data): POST /movement. Also calls revalidateTag('tags') after creation. Replaced by useCreateMovement hook.

functions.getTagsByUser(): GET /tag/user/:userId. Returns Tags[]. Replaced by useTags hook.
functions.revalidateTags(): Calls revalidateTag('tags'). Legacy — postMovement already calls revalidateTag('tags') directly.

functions.getFinancialElementsByUser(): DEPRECATED CACHE — GET /financial-element/patrimony wrapped in unstable_cache (tag: 'financial-elements', revalidate: 3600). Returns FinancialElementsAndNetWorth. Still called in patrimonio/page.tsx. Should be replaced by useFinancialElements hook (not yet implemented).
functions.getFinancialElementById(id): GET /financial-element/:id. Returns FinancialElements (single element with its movements). No hook.
functions.postFinancialElement(data): POST /financial-element with { name, type, userId }. No hook.
functions.revalidateFinancialElements(): Calls revalidateTag('financial-elements'). Legacy — still called in patrimonio/page.tsx, patrimonio/[id]/page.tsx, and asset-form-modal.tsx.

functions.postSubscriptionNotifications(data): POST /notifications with { endpoint, p256dh, auth, userId }. Web Push subscription.

tanstackHooks.description: TanStack Query hooks wrapping server actions. QueryClient is provided at app root. All useQuery hooks use staleTime: 0 (always refetch when stale). Mutations invalidate relevant query keys on success.
